<!-- kb: {"priority":2} -->
## Why
ADR-006: the store becomes local and single-host, and a dispatcher in GitHub Actions cannot read it. The maintainer never used it. Deleting it now means the runtime seam that follows (track B) has three adapters to write, not four (`docs/local-first.md` §1 item 6, §7).

## What
Delete, do not stub:
- `templates/actions/` and `actionsFiles` / `--with-actions` in `src/init.js` (an unknown-flag error that says the runner was removed in ADR-006 and names `hkb up` as the way to keep a board moving).
- The `claude-action` profile in `DEFAULT_PROFILES` (`src/board.js`), and `mode: 'trigger'` everywhere: the trigger tail of `spawnWorker`, the `remote` branch of the reclaim loop and every `a.remote` read in `src/dispatch.js`; `loadBoard` should refuse a board.json that still names `mode: "trigger"` with a message that says so.
- The doctor checks about the workflows and the Actions secrets in `src/doctor.js`; `test/actions.test.js`.
- `README.md` "Runs when the laptop is closed" and every mention of `claude-action`; the Actions section of `docs/harnesses.md`; the "Actions runner" mentions in `docs/wiki/` pages (`architecture/overview.md`, `features/up-and-down.md`, `concepts/worker-identity.md`, `decisions/adr-004-roles-and-adoption.md` is a record and stays as written).
Keep: `--profiles` on `hkb dispatch` (a host says which profiles it launches), `manual` attempts and their heartbeat-only liveness, `heartbeat: comment` (a later card removes it with the GitHub store).

## Done when
- [ ] `grep -rn "claude-action\|kanban-dispatch\|kanban-worker\|with-actions\|'trigger'\|\.remote\b" src bin templates skills README.md docs --include=*.js --include=*.md --include=*.yml` returns nothing outside `docs/EVALUATION.md`, `docs/status.md`, `docs/wiki/log.md` and ADR-004/005/006 (history stays).
- [ ] `hkb init --with-actions` exits 2 with a message naming ADR-006.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` green; `node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` reports nothing stale.

## Contract
Do not touch `src/tasks.js` or `src/lock.js` beyond removing dead imports: the next card (A3) moves them. Do not rename anything in `spawnWorker`'s signature.

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` (the plan; the sections named below), `docs/wiki/decisions/adr-005-control-plane.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Keep it dependency-free at runtime. Pure logic in
`src/model.js` with a test. Errors name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere. Update the wiki page a
change touches (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` lists what went stale); a new feature gets a new page.
Finish with `npm run lint && npm test` green, one draft PR, and exactly one terminal verb.
goal: no file references kanban-dispatch.yml, claude-action, mode trigger or a remote attempt; init --with-actions is an unknown flag with a message; tests green
title: Remove the GitHub Actions runner: templates, claude-action, trigger mode, remote liveness
